messages.content: PT-1006: Did u get my reading from Tuesday? Missed the 2pm checkin. Need to know if my pressure's trending down.
Northline: Hi! I see your Tuesday reading. What's today's reading?
PT-1006: That's weird—I logged it at 2pm Tuesday. Are you guys not getting those? Hasn't improved btw. Still 155–160 range.

Northline: Thanks for that. Can you give today's exact reading so I can log it? For whether your trend means you need a medication change, I need to escalate to a nurse—median wait is 31 hours right now.
PT-1006: Are you serious? STOP. I'm not waiting 31 hours for advice. I'll call my doctor.
Northline: I understand. You're off check-ins now. You're making the right call with your doctor—they can adjust meds. Sorry we couldn't respond faster.

theme: wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply
